name: Tahunga Golf Club
description: A seasonal 9-hole country course wrapped by the Hangaroa River, located one hour inland from Gisborne between the Rere and Waerengaokuri districts. Golf in its purest rural form, with rough edges, character, and a welcoming community hub.

name: Waikohu Golf Club
description: A 9-hole course set among rolling farmland near Te Karaka, about 30 minutes from Gisborne. An active community club with members who regularly compete at regional and national level, including the NZ Maori Golf Association championships.

name: Patutahi Golf Club
description: A small country club 20 minutes from Gisborne city, renowned for its top-quality greens. The well-maintained putting surfaces and peaceful rural surroundings make it a rewarding detour from the main Gisborne courses.

name: Te Puia Hot Springs Golf Club
description: An 18-hole hilltop course on the East Cape overlooking the Pacific Ocean and Mount Hikurangi, featuring raised tees, deep gullies, and forested fairway edges. The annual East Coast Open tournament has drawn golfers from across New Zealand for over 50 years. A truly unique setting that rewards the journey along State Highway 35.

name: Poverty Bay Golf Club
description: A scenic links-influenced course in Gisborne, the first city in the world to see the sunrise each day. Coastal character and well-maintained fairways make it the premier golfing destination on the East Cape.

name: Gisborne Park Golf Club
description: The main parkland course in Gisborne, set in the first city in the world to greet each new day's sun. A well-maintained layout offering an enjoyable round in a region rich with Maori culture and stunning coastal scenery.

name: Wairoa Golf Club
description: A rural club in the small town of Wairoa, offering very affordable golf between Gisborne and Napier. A relaxed, no-frills course ideal for golfers passing through the northern Hawke's Bay region.

name: Tolaga Bay Golf Club
description: A remote 9-hole course on the East Cape, offering a genuine off-the-beaten-track golfing experience. One for adventurous golfers exploring the spectacular and uncrowded coastal scenery of State Highway 35.

name: Ruatoria Golf Club
description: A very remote rural course deep on the East Cape, one of New Zealand's most affordable places to play. An authentic backcountry experience for golfers seeking something truly different on the Pacific Coast Highway.
